title: Cosh_G(X,1_Q) ≃ Cosh_{G'}(X',1_{Q'}) under induced structure (Prop 4.1)
body_html:
$\Cosh_G(X, \mathbf 1_Q) \simeq \Cosh_{G'}(X', \mathbf 1_{Q'})$

Setting: $X = G \times^P X'$ where $P$ is a cosheaf of subgroups of $G$ on $X'$, $P'_E := G' \cap P_E$, and additionally:

  • a $G'$-equivariant sheaf $Q'$ of subgroups of $G'$ on $X'$ with $Q'_E \trianglelefteq P'_E$;
  • a $G'$-equivariant cosheaf $J$ of subgroups of $G$ on $X'$ with $J_E \trianglelefteq P_E$;
  • $P'_E / Q'_E \;\xrightarrow{\sim}\; P_E / Q_E$ for $Q_E := Q'_E J_E$.

Then $\{Q_E\}$ extends uniquely to a family on all of $X$ with $g Q_E g^{-1} = Q_{gE}$.

Let $\mathbf 1_Q := \{\mathbf 1_{Q_E}\}$, $\mathbf 1_{Q'} := \{\mathbf 1_{Q'_E}\}$ be the trivial-character families. Write $\Cosh_G(X, R, \mathbf 1_Q)$ for the cosheaves on which each $Q_E$ acts trivially.

Proposition (Sheaf7 Prop 4.1). $\Cosh_G(X, R, \mathbf 1_Q) \simeq \Cosh_{G'}(X', R, \mathbf 1_{Q'})$.
proof_html: Use the QFD equivalence $[X']_{[X/G]} \to [X/G]$ (see Reduction of G-equivariant cosheaves to a QFD (Prop 2.6.3)) to view any $\mathscr{V} \in \Cosh_G(X,R,\mathbf 1_Q)$ as a functor on $X'$; restrict $\mathscr{V}$ along $[X'/G'] \subseteq [X']_{[X/G]}$ to get $\mathscr{V}' \in \Cosh_{G'}(X', R, \mathbf 1_{Q'})$, using $Q'_E \subseteq Q_E$. Conversely, given $\mathscr{W} \in \Cosh_{G'}(X', R, \mathbf 1_{Q'})$, use $P_E = P'_E J_E$ (and $\Fix_G(E) = \Fix_{G'}(E) J_E$) to equip $\mathscr{V}_E := \mathscr{W}_E$ with the trivial $J_E$-action and apply Reduction of G-equivariant cosheaves to a QFD (Prop 2.6.3) (with $K = J$). The two constructions are quasi-inverse. $\square$
